messages:
Jordan: FYI Velora renewal stuck. AP won't accept PO until vendor code matches their ERP. Legal signoff done but procurement blocked.
Maya: Which vendor_code do they expect?
Sam: They replied with: vendor_code VEL-OPS-US_A and tax_id must match the billing entity.
Maya: Customer said they can put us on CC for month 1 while AP processes PO. Want to avoid losing the renewal.
Alex: If we shorten from 12 to 9 months we need a formal amendment and updated pricing. Will calculate pro-rate.
Priya_legal: We can do a 1-paragraph amendment. Need explicit clause: "Contract term set to nine (9) months; fees pro-rated as attached." Also confirm signature order.
Sam: Procurement insists vendor_code field is visible on signed pdf/invoice. They won't retroactively approve a PO without that.
Jordan: Can billing include vendor_code on the invoice PDF and on DocuSign metadata?
billing-bot: Yes. We can inject vendor_code into invoice template and DocuSign custom field. Need confirmation of exact value.
Maya: Confirm exact: VEL-OPS-US_A and billing_entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Sam: I'll add procurement contact procurement_ops@velora.com to the envelope as CC so AP sees it immediately.
Alex: New numbers: 12mo list = $12,000. 9mo pro-rate = $9,000. I'll add a line item showing pro-rated credit for term change. Link: https://app.redwood/quotes/QR-7812
Priya_legal: Approve amendment language. Add a 30-day notice for renewals. No other contract changes.
Maya: DocuSign updated and sent at 10:41 PT. Signer order: Customer Exec -> Procurement (cc). Envelope includes amended quote and invoice with vendor_code.
account-exec: Customer replied "Will sign today if the vendor_code appears on the invoice and DocuSign." They confirmed CC for first invoice.
Jordan: Follow-up plan: if PO not visible in 5 business days, process CC for invoice #INV-9001 for first month and hold remaining until PO completes.
billing-bot: CC fallback enabled on INV-9001. Invoice draft includes vendor_code: VEL-OPS-US_A.
Sam: I updated internal vendor registry and linked procurement_ops@velora.com. AP acknowledged receipt and said ~3-5 business days.
Maya: Great. I'll watch DocuSign and ping AP in 48 hours if no PO. Leaving thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
_meta: Slack thread about renewal exec: vendor code, amendment for term change, CC fallback, invoice metadata. Single-thread string per agents.md schema.
